info.comment: Flat vector food product: desk lentil tin. A short cylindrical metal tin, gray body, navy lid, simple lentil ovals in rust-brown #B86A3D on the front as a pictogram only. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, limited palette navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray, rust, white. No text, no letters, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered, crisp edges.
